meta.source: GeoNames cities15000 (CC BY 4.0) for place names; PVGIS v5.2 PVcalc and MRcalc for yield, monthly shape and temperature, fetched at each city's own coordinates
meta.usage: specificYield35S is kWh/kWp/year at tilt=35/south incl. 14% system loss. monthlyShape holds 12 fractions of the annual yield (Jan..Dec). monthlyMeanTempC holds 12 monthly mean air temperatures. All three are measured at the city's own coordinates, so altitude is reflected -- do not substitute a coarse grid lookup, which misplaced alpine cities by 8 K.
